stem:
The diagram shows Seema's aluminium strip. A flame heats the left end. Drawing pins P, Q, R and S are stuck with wax along the strip, with P nearest the flame and S farthest.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: Heat moves by conduction from the hot end toward colder parts, so the pins fall in the order P, then Q, then R, then S.
Heat moves by conduction from the cold end toward the flame, so the pins fall in the order S, then R, then Q, then P.
Only pin P can fall, because heat never leaves the flame end of a solid strip.
All four pins fall at the same instant because aluminium is one solid piece.

teacher.key_rationale: In a heated solid strip, heat conducts from the hot end to colder parts, so wax nearest the flame softens first and pins fall P→Q→R→S.
teacher.figure_note: Aluminium strip with flame and wax-held pins P–S.
